sources.title: Amazon Bedrock now offers Pixtral Large 25.02
sources.evidence: The April 8, 2025 announcement explicitly names 25.02, describes 124B parameters and native function calling, and announces managed Bedrock availability. This proves the provider rollout, not necessarily the first public release of this revision.

sources.title: Pixtral Large (25.02) parameters and inference
sources.evidence: The exact-version inference page states 124B parameters, 128K context, native function calling and Mistral Research License. Its request and tool examples use mistral.pixtral-large-2502-v1:0. It supplies no downloadable 2502 checkpoint or explicit dedicated reasoning-mode classification.

sources.title: Pixtral Large is now available in Amazon Bedrock
sources.evidence: April 10, 2025 post identifies mistral.pixtral-large-2502-v1:0 and states 124B overall, split into a 123B multimodal decoder and 1B vision encoder, plus an explicit 128,000-token context and tool use. These are nominal published counts, not tensor-level totals.

sources.title: Pixtral Large model card
sources.evidence: The card maps to the exact 2502 model ID; it marks image/text input, text output and client-side tools supported. Its Nov 19, 2024 launch date conflicts with the dated April 8, 2025 25.02 rollout and is not adopted as this revision’s first release.

sources.title: Pinned Pixtral Large 24.11 model definition
sources.evidence: Pinned schema version 24.11 links Pixtral-Large-Instruct-2411 and API names pixtral-large-2411/latest, with parameters 124 and active 124. This is explicit evidence for 2411 only; it contains no 2502 alias or equivalence statement.

sources.title: Pinned model weights table renderer
sources.evidence: The renderer labels the schema columns Parameters (B) and Active (B), establishing billion-parameter units. It does not extend the 2411 row to the 2502 variant.

sources.title: Pixtral-Large-Instruct-2411 model card and weights
sources.evidence: Official public checkpoint is explicitly 2411. The card gives 124B overall, 123B decoder and 1B vision encoder, with research licensing. No exact 2502 checkpoint or identity mapping was found here, so its configuration and tensors are not transferred.

sources.title: Official Mistral Hugging Face Pixtral repository inventory
sources.evidence: The author-filtered repository search returned Pixtral-12B-Base-2409, Pixtral-Large-Instruct-2411 and Pixtral-12B-2409. It returned no 2502 checkpoint; this bounded search is not proof that 2502 is closed-weight.

sources.title: Mistral official changelog
sources.evidence: The changelog records pixtral-large-2411 on November 18, 2024. The accessed full page contains no pixtral-large-2502 entry, so it does not resolve the first public release of 2502.

sources.title: Pixtral Large legal lifecycle
sources.evidence: The family-level page says it includes subsequent versions, but the sole release row is the base Pixtral Large dated November 18, 2024. It provides no separately dated or downloadable 2502 revision.

sources.title: Initial Models.dev Pixtral Large 2502 base record
sources.evidence: The base record introduced on September 9, 2026 assigns April 8, 2025, open_weights false and reasoning false without an exact-version primary citation. These catalog assertions are leads rather than independent proof.

sources.title: Initial Models.dev Bedrock Pixtral Large 2502 provider record
sources.evidence: The provider record added March 13, 2026 already sets April 8, 2025 and false openness/reasoning, without primary evidence establishing an earlier developer release, exact checkpoint availability or dedicated reasoning-mode absence.

sources.title: Later Mistral Large 3 model card
sources.evidence: The later official card was searched for Pixtral comparisons; it contains no Pixtral mention and no exact 2502 total/active column.

sources.title: Later Mistral Small 3.1 model card
sources.evidence: The later official card was searched for Pixtral comparisons; it contains no Pixtral mention and no exact 2502 architecture or active-count disclosure.

sources.title: Pinned official model schema index
sources.evidence: The complete pinned tree and 77 model-schema TypeScript files were searched. Pixtral references resolve to 2409 and 2411 entries; no 2502 row or alias supplies exact total/active comparison data.

name.note: Exact dated variant name is used by AWS; parentheses are catalog formatting.

developer.note: AWS explicitly attributes the model to Mistral AI; retain the existing normalized developer label.

family.note: Pixtral Large is identified as a Mistral model family; retain the normalized pixtral family key.

release_date.note: April 8, 2025 is explicitly the Bedrock rollout; a first public release of exact 2502 is not established. Mistral dates 2411/base to November 18, 2024, while AWS currently lists November 19, 2024. Neither family date nor the 2502 suffix proves a 2502 release day or month. Clear the catalog assertion pending exact release evidence.

open_weights.note: AWS’s MRL statement establishes a license classification, not downloadable 2502 weights. The official schema and repository inventory identify 2411 weights only. No exact equivalence or explicit closed-weight statement was found; clear false rather than infer either answer from the sibling.

license.note: The exact 25.02 inference page explicitly names Mistral Research License. This classification does not establish 2502 checkpoint distribution; hosted-service terms are a separate matter.

parameters_b.note: Nominal published total in billions for exact 25.02. AWS’s same-ID post splits it into a 123B decoder and 1B vision encoder, so 124 covers the multimodal model rather than text only. No tensor-level precision is implied.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact-2502 active count found in the accessed AWS docs, pinned 77-file Mistral schema inventory, later Large 3/Small 3.1 cards or targeted primary-source searches. The explicit 124B active column belongs to 2411 only. Do not equate total and active or transfer that row.

architecture.note: AWS establishes a multimodal decoder plus vision encoder, but no exact-2502 primary configuration or technical/interpretability report establishing the catalog’s dense/MoE architecture was found. 2411 architecture cannot be transferred without version equivalence.

context_window.note: AWS explicitly specifies 128,000 tokens for the exact 2502 endpoint. This is the documented provider limit; no native 2502 checkpoint limit is established. Do not replace it with 2411 configuration’s 131,072.

modalities.note: Exact-ID AWS modality table supports text and image input and text output; no audio or video input/output is marked supported.

reasoning.note: Generic mathematical/visual reasoning claims do not establish a dedicated reasoning mode. Exact AWS API examples and capabilities do not explicitly classify such a mode positively or negatively; Models.dev false is unsupported by a primary negative statement. Clear false.

tool_call.note: Exact-version announcement states native function calling; the inference guide supplies 2502 tool-call examples, and the exact-ID card marks client-side tool calling supported.

description.value: Mistral vision-language model for image understanding and multimodal chat
description.note: Narrow baseline description is supported by exact-version image/text inputs, text outputs and conversational API examples; it contains no unsupported benchmark or architectural claim.

patch.notes: Exact 25.02 is documented on Amazon Bedrock with a nominal 124B multimodal total (123B decoder plus 1B vision encoder), 128,000-token provider context and Mistral Research License. April 8, 2025 is the Bedrock rollout; the revision’s first public release remains unverified. Published Pixtral 2411 weights and its explicit 124B active count are not proven identical to 2502. Exact weight availability, architecture, active count and dedicated reasoning-mode classification remain unresolved.

summary: Adds exact-variant nominal 124B total and the AWS-documented Mistral Research License. Confirms name, developer, family, provider context, modalities, tools and baseline description. Clears unsupported first-release, closed-weight and no-reasoning assertions. Active parameters and architecture remain unresolved because later primary comparison/schema evidence and downloadable weights are specifically 2411, with no verified 2502 equivalence. No weight shards were downloaded or counted.
